ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of approximately 3:1 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous fields across both lobes. Black pigmentation forms a solid wedge at the peduncle base and a thick continuous band along the upper distal margin of the right lobe. Discrete small black speckles (1-5 pixel diameter) are mapped across the medial region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow U-shaped depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 18 degrees and a depth of roughly 45 pixels from the trailing edge apex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations (peaks and valleys of 2-4 pixels) observed along the trailing edges of both lobes; a prominent irregular notch is visible on the distal third of the left lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe exhibits a smooth convex curve from the notch to the tip; the right lobe follows a steeper convex trajectory with a sharp angular turn at the distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of approximately 12-15 small dark pixel clusters on the white background of the left lobe, primarily concentrated in the mid-section and near the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small, jagged indentation/notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe near the outer tip.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity vertical pixel streaks (water droplets) originating from the trailing edge of the left lobe and descending into the water surface.
